sections.label: Southeast Asians joining ISIS
sections.summary: Regional authorities estimate up to 1,000 Southeast Asians have travelled to Syria and Iraq to join ISIS, and Singapore has detained a small number of radicalised Singaporeans planning lone-wolf attacks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: Regional authorities estimate that as many as 1,000 Southeast Asians have travelled to Syria and Iraq to join ISIS.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: In Singapore, we have had to detain a small number of radicalised Singaporeans who were planning to stage "lone-wolf" attacks in Singapore.

sections.label: Rising cybercrime rates
sections.summary: High Internet and mobile penetration rates have led to rising cybercrime, which is driving up overall crime rates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: With our high Internet and mobile penetration rates, cybercrime has also been on the rise, which is driving up overall crime rates.

sections.label: Police Cameras at HDB blocks
sections.summary: The Singapore Police Force will complete installation of Police Cameras at all HDB blocks and multi-storey carparks in 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: Inland, the Singapore Police Force (SPF) will complete the installation of Police Cameras at all HDB blocks and multi-storey carparks in 2016.

sections.label: Emergency ambulance calls increasing
sections.summary: Emergency ambulance calls are increasing at a rate of 5% a year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: For example, emergency ambulance calls are increasing at a rate of 5% a year.

sections.label: Mobile crowd-sourcing for crime-reporting
sections.summary: SPF will reach out to millions of mobile device users for real-time crime-reporting and leads by extending its crowd-sourcing reach to mobile platforms.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: SPF will reach out to millions of mobile device users for real-time crime-reporting and leads, through extending its crowd-sourcing reach to mobile platforms.

sections.label: Combating terrorism and drugs
sections.summary: To combat terrorism, Singapore will share intelligence and support international initiatives against radicalisation, and will work with like-minded countries on a zero-tolerance stance against drugs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: To combat terrorism, we will share intelligence, as well as support international initiatives, to counter radicalisation and address the root causes of extremism.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: To combat the scourge of drugs, we will work with like-minded countries to affirm a zero-tolerance stance to prevent harm from drug abuse and stand firm against pressures to decriminalise and legitimise drug consumption.

sections.label: Home Team single scheme
sections.summary: Degree and non-degree holders will be placed on a single scheme of service within each Home Team Department, and specialist career tracks will be developed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: Degree and non-degree holders will be placed on a single scheme of service within each Home Team Department.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We will also develop specialist career tracks to build officers with deep expertise in specialist domains.
